programs.name: 2-Step Day & Swing
programs.profit_split: Day: 80% (90%/100% with add-ons); Swing: 70% -> 80% -> 90% by payout

profit_split_scale: 2-Step Swing: 70% (1st payout) -> 80% (2nd) -> 90% (3rd onward); other accounts raise split only via checkout add-ons (90%/100%)
leverage: Up to 1:50: FX majors 1:50; EURGBP/GBPJPY and FX minors/exotics 1:30; indices 1:15-1:40 (US100 1:30, US30 1:40, GER30 1:30, JPN225 1:40, US500 1:25, UK100 1:20); metals 1:20; oil 1:10; other commodities 1:1; BTC 1:10, ETH/SOL/XRP 1:5, other crypto 1:1
payout_frequency: 2-Step Pro6/Pro10, 2-Step Day/Swing and 1-Step Pro: first payout 21 days after the first funded trade, then every 21 days (14-day add-on). Instant Funding: on-demand once eligible per the Instant help article (accounts bought on/after 8 Oct 2026); homepage table says 7 days and homepage FAQ / add-ons article say every 14 days.
payout_speed: 24-48 hours, weekends excluded (Rise or USDT); Payout Guarantee: processed within 2 business days or $500 cash + $500 account credit
consistency_rule: 1-Step Pro funded: largest day <= 50% of total profit; Instant Funding: <= 15%; 2-Step Pro6/Pro10: none (exceeding delays payout, not a breach)

notes: List prices from the fundingtraders.com homepage challenge table (all four tabs present in page HTML; re-checked 2026-10-31, unchanged). The homepage shows each price struck through next to a 50%-off price, which matches the posted first-challenge code TRYFT (50% off first challenge); a site-wide banner (homepage + app login) advertises code HALLOWIN = 70% OFF ('limited time', no end date shown), and the help-centre Promotions article lists code HALLOWEEN (50% off + free matching account + all add-ons, valid Oct 26-31, 2026). 2-Step Day & Swing is documented in the help centre as a newly launched 2-Step variant (5K-200K, MT5/TradeLocker) but is not priced on the homepage table, so its fees are null. A free $1,000 'Try Out' 1-Step Pro account (MT5 only, new users via tryout.fundingtraders.com) exists and is excluded from fee_from. Rule conflicts on the firm's own pages: homepage table shows 4 min trading days for 1-Step Pro but the 1-Step Pro help article says 2 (used 2); Instant payout schedule is '7 Days' on the homepage table, 'every 14 days' in the homepage FAQ/add-ons article and 'On-Demand' in the Instant help article; General Trading Guidelines (Mar 2026) say Instant accounts cannot hold over the weekend while the newer Instant article (Oct 2026) says they can; homepage FAQ says the fee is refunded with the first payout while Terms s.10.1 and program articles say with the second payout (Instant: 200% refund bonus). Instant max loss trails until +3% then locks at initial balance; 1-Step Pro max loss trails from highest balance. News: challenge phases unrestricted; funded Pro accounts cap news-influenced profit at 30% (trades opened/held/closed within 5 min of red-folder news; 5h+ holds exempt); Instant: no opening/closing within the 10-minute window (hard breach). weekend_holding 'allowed' for Pro/Swing/Instant (current articles); 2-Step Day auto-closes non-crypto positions at 16:55 NY daily and before the Friday close. HQ: footer lists FT US Inc (901 Pennsylvania Ave, Miami Beach, FL, US) and Funding Traders Group Ltd (Saint Lucia, Company No. 2025-00298); Trustpilot company profile shows Dubai, U.A.E. founded=2023 from the app login page ('2023 Established'). Restricted-country list from the site footer, although the live payout tracker shows payouts to traders listed in Vietnam and Morocco. Homepage claims 53,000+ accounts funded; app login claims over $8M paid. CAUTION (payout complaints): Trustpilot (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/fundingtraders.com, checked 2026-10-31) shows 'This company's rating is unavailable due to a breach of our guidelines' and 'We've removed a number of fake reviews for this company' (3,283 reviews; distribution 68% 5-star / 24% 1-star). Recent reviews (Oct 2026) include complaints of second payouts delayed over a week with slow risk-team replies, Instant accounts terminated when a payout was requested (cited news-trading breaches on BTCUSD), terminations for exceeding the 1% floating-risk limit by small amounts, a disputed daily-drawdown reset on an overnight hold, and a dispute over whether holding through news was allowed; other recent reviews report payouts received within 24 hours. Listed with caution; no regulator action seen on the firm's site.
category_basis: Sells simulated forex/CFD evaluations and instant accounts on MetaTrader 5 and TradeLocker (forex, indices, metals, oil, crypto CFDs); no futures or exchange accounts.
max_allocation_text: Up to $400K in funding (largest Instant Funding account $400K); no scaling plan published
